name: trace-telemetry-workspace
description: TRACE Telemetry: the Python analysis core (core/) and the desktop application (app/).

scripts.start: npm run setup:core && npm run start --workspace app
scripts.dev: npm run setup:core && npm run dev --workspace app
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:app
scripts.test:app: npm run setup:core && npm run test --workspace app
